# Fight Club preview with an expired horde target

The original reward branch of random campaign 25 exposes a played-card
boundary after 23 inputs. The native preview has a wounded champion, the
original Sycophant and Recruit, and an expired cached target. A new three-horde
Funguy with Fight Club receives three champion health writes: 12 to 21, 21 to
30, and 30 to 39. The cached target list remains unchanged during preview.

`player-fight-club-missing-horde-preview-{calibration,replay-calibration}.mt2f`
capture separate native processes before and after the limited guard change.
The focused check compares every input, successor, forecast and RNG, checks the
three observed writes, exercises four concurrent branches and perturbs eight
source identities. The earlier Fight Club fourth-write pair and the 390
four-horde Goldy pair also pass. The expired spawn point does not establish the
identity of an unobserved object. This component result is not a campaign win.
